name: Maruti Global Industries Limited
about: Maruti Global Industries Limited engages in investment, Underwriting, and subunderwriting business in India. The company invests in, acquires and holds, sells, buys in shares, debentures, stocks, bonds, units, and other securities. It is also involved in construction and infrastructure development. The company was formerly known as Maruti Securities Limited and changed its name to Maruti Global Industries Limited in October 2025. Maruti Global Industries Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
